errors.what: Wheel phase is inconsistent around the driver wrap. The wheel rests at 150 deg from driver 60 to 300, then reads 143.8 at driver 330, so it is already moving at 330 and should be heading to 120 deg at 360. It instead shows 180 at driver 0, a 60 deg jump in the panel. The entry half of the indexing is wrong: at driver 330 the wheel should be about 203.8 deg (mirror of 156.2 at driver 30), not 143.8. The wheel does not advance consistently over one revolution (it should net 60 deg clockwise per revolution for n=6).
